patches.text: Eye of Newt — Potions now hit one additional random target (upgraded: ALL valid targets). Now creates an Unstable Ember Jar instead of a Noxious Brew.
Cloak of Moonlight — Now costs 1 (was 2). Triggers on Hex instead of card/potion creation: whenever you trigger Hex, gain Block.
Polymorph — Transforms are now 1:1: Transform 2 cards in your Draw Pile into a Rats each (was: each chosen card became 2 Rats); upgrade now transforms 3 cards (was cost reduction).
Call the Pack — Block 6 → 7. Upgrade now shuffles upgraded Gnash+ into your draw pile (upgrade Block bonus 3 → 2, no longer adds a third Gnash).
Creeping Vines — Brambles 6 → 7.
Bottomless Cauldron — Upgrade now grants Innate (was cost reduction).
Read the Bones — Upgrade now grants +1 draw next turn (was +1 Energy next turn).
Incant — Upgrade now grants +1 Hex (was +3 Block).
Embrace the Wilds — Upgrade now also upgrades the draw penalty.
Bottle Barrage — Damage 7 → 6 (upgrade +3 → +2).
Ambush! — Cost 1 → 2, Damage 10 → 9.
Refuse Pile — Block 13 → 11.
Harvest — Upgrade now grants +2 Damage (was +1 Potion).
Capture Soul — Cost 0 → 1, Hex 2 → 1.
Hexblast — Hex 3 → 2.
Read the Bones — Hex 3 → 2.
Incant — Hex 2 → 1.
Vexing Strike — Damage 9 → 7 (upgrade +3 → +2).
Torment — Damage 5 → 3.
Volatile Vapors — Damage per potion 6 → 5.
Wax and Wane — Stacks 2 → 1.
Cursed Spellbook — Energy 3 → 2 (upgrade now restores +1 Energy and +1 card).
Nimble (Cat token) — Now Energy only, no longer gains Block.
Vial of Smoke — Block 8 → 7.
Hidden in Smoke — Created Puffs of Smoke are now Unstable.
Rip Soul — Created Potions are now Unstable.
Pack Tactics — New Wolf familiar token: Gain 2 Strength this turn (upgraded: 4).
Ash — New Status card (Unplayable, Ethereal), left behind by fire cards.
Wolf Familiar — Now grants a random token each turn: Gnash or Pack Tactics (was: always Gnash).
Bonfire — Now adds 2 Ash into your Discard Pile. Ash can't be chosen for the Exhaust.
Tinder — Now adds an Ash into your Discard Pile. Ash can't be used as kindling.
Bottomless Cauldron — Upgrade now reduces cost by 1 (was Innate).
Hide in a Bush — Block 7 → 6.
Incant — Block 8 → 7.
Smolder — Block 5 → 4.
Wax and Wane — Block 8 → 7.
Toil and Trouble — Damage 5 → 4.
Volatile Vapors — Damage per potion 5 → 4 (upgrade +3 → +2).
Weathered Witch Hat — Upgrade +3 → +2 Block.
Deep Roots — Upgrade +2 → +1.
Dark Omen (Crow token) — Hex 2 → 1.
Ember Jar — Damage 5 → 4.
Noxious Brew — Damage 10 → 8.
Witchcraft — Created Potions are now Unstable.
Prices Paid — Created Noxious Brews are now Unstable.
Blood Anointment — New Uncommon Skill (1 Energy, Multiplayer only): Choose another player. Their Attacks apply 1 Hex this turn (upgrade: costs 0).
Plague Tide — New Rare Power (2 Energy, Multiplayer only): ALL players Summon a Rat Familiar (upgrade: Rat Familiar+).
Smolder — Now: Gain 5 Block, create an Unstable Ember Jar immediately (was: Gain 4 Block, create one at the start of each of the next 2 turns). The Smolder power is gone.
Torment — Now Common. Damage 3 → 5 (upgrade +2 → +3); no longer draws a card.
Ritual Sacrifice — Exhaust 3 → 2 cards, Hex 7 → 6. Upgrade now +1 card and +1 Hex (was +3 Hex).
Hidden in Smoke — Upgrade now reduces cost by 1 (was Innate).
Nimble (Cat token) — Nimble+ now also gains 2 Block.
Dark Omen (Crow token) — Now applies Hex to ALL enemies (was single target).
Crystal Bottle — Healing Potions can no longer be bottled.
Wicked Brew — Creates Fertilizer instead of Flex Potion; Fertilizer removed from Stony Brew's table.
Separatory Funnel — Now the Witch's Ancient Orobas relic (replaces Bottomless Pockets, which is removed).
Cozy Nest — Shop → Rare relic.
Wormy's Apple — Uncommon → Shop relic.
Buddy in a Bottle — Rare → Uncommon potion.
Bear Familiar — Cost 1 → 0.
Hexblast — Cost 3 → 2, Damage 8 → 7.
Rummage (Rat token) — Cost 1 → 0.
Sprouts — Upgrade now also +2 Brambles.
Weathered Witch Hat — Upgrade +2 → +3 Block.
Brambleburst — Cost 2 → 3, damage per Bramble 1 → 2.
Creeping Vines — Brambles 7 → 5.
Owl Familiar — Cost 1 → 2.
Rat Familiar — Cost 1 → 2.
Bag of Teeth — Common → Uncommon.
Wicker Heart – New Rare Skill (1 Energy, Retain, Exhaust): Gain 5 Brambles. If you have 10 Brambles, add Wicker Bones to your Hand (upgrade: 7 Brambles, adds Wicker Bones+).
Wicker Bones – Created by Wicker Heart (1 Energy, Exhaust): Gain 12 Block. If you have 30 Brambles, add Wicker Consumation to your Hand (upgrade: 16 Block).
Wicker Consumation – Created by Wicker Bones (1 Energy, Exhaust): Deal 20 damage. If you have at least 50 Brambles, gain Incarnation.
Vile Renewal – New Uncommon Skill (1 Energy): Gain 5 Block. Attacks do not remove Hex or Brambles this turn (upgrade: 8 Block).
Tasty Herbs – Now: Whenever you use an Unstable potion, 25% chance it is used an additional time (was: heal 3 HP at the end of combat if you used a potion).
Eye of Newt – Creates an Unstable Noxious Brew instead of an Unstable Ember Jar.
Cloak of Moonlight – Block gained from Hex triggers is no longer modified by Dexterity.
Extract Life – Cost 2 → 1.
Eye of Newt – Cost 2 → 1.
Brambleburst – Cost 3 → 2, Rare → Uncommon, damage per Bramble 2 → 1.
Blood Anointment – Uncommon → Rare.
Puff of Smoke – Block 4 → 3.
Grind Down — No longer offers Entropic Brew.
Moth Familiar – Common 2-cost Power. Summons a Moth that each turn adds either Star Dust (apply 4 Moonlight, 6 when upgraded) or Gossamer (gain 4 Block, 5 when upgraded) to your hand.
Cloak of Twilight – 1-cost Uncommon Power. Whenever you trigger Hex, gain 2 Block (3 when upgraded). This is the old Cloak of Moonlight effect.
Cloak of Moonlight – Uncommon 2-Cost Power: Whenever you create a card or Potion, apply 1 Moonlight to a random enemy. Upgrade grants Innate
Moonbeam – Deal 10 damage, apply 10 Moonlight (12 / 12 when upgraded).

Salt and Ash – Was a 2-cost Attack (12 damage to ALL, stabilize a Potion, Exhaust). Now a 1-cost Skill: gain 6 Block, whenever you play a Skill this turn deal 3 damage to ALL enemies (8 Block / 4 damage when upgraded).
Smolder – Now creates an Unstable Ember Jar at the start of each of the next 2 turns instead of one immediately. Block 5 → 4 (upgrade +3 → +2).
Wild Growth – No longer doubles Brambles. Now: at the start of each of the next 2 turns, gain 1 Energy and 5 Brambles. Cost 1 → 2, no longer Exhausts (upgrade adds a turn instead of reducing cost).
Mulch – Now always adds X cards even if fewer were exhausted.
Hasty Brew – Upgrade now costs 0 instead of removing Exhaust.
Ferocity – Upgrade now costs 0 instead of +2 damage.
Pocket Rats – Upgrade now adds Rats+ instead of an extra Rats.
Strike Fear – Upgrade now only adds +1 Vulnerable (no longer +2 damage).
Wax and Wane – Upgrade now +3 Block (was +1 Block and +1 Hex).
Share the Brew – Potions granted are now Unstable.
Wicker Consumation – Can now be upgraded (+5 damage). Wicker Bones+ creates Wicker Consumation+.
Fertilizer / Prickly Vial – Brambles now go to the targeted player in multiplayer.
Flock – Renamed to Animal Handling.
Bottle Barrage – Cost 1 → 2.
Call the Pack – Upgrade Block +2 → +3.
Creeping Vines – Uncommon → Rare. Brambles 5 → 6.
Deep Roots – Brambles per turn 3 → 2.
Needle Whip – Damage 9 → 8.
Pack Tactics – Strength 2 → 3.
Polymorph – Rare → Uncommon.
Sprouts – Upgrade Brambles +2 → +1.
Volatile Vapors – Damage 4 → 3 (upgrade +2 → +1).
Mulch – Now adds one random card per card actually Exhausted (was always X cards, even if you Exhausted fewer).
Incant – Upgrade now +3 Block (was +1 Hex).
Smolder – Upgrade now +1 turn of Ember Jars (was +2 Block).
Wax and Wane – Upgrade now +1 Hex (was +3 Block).
Cloak of Moonlight – Upgrade now costs 1 (was Innate).
Polymorph – Now Exhausts.
Moth Familiar – Cost 2 → 1.
Star Dust – Moonlight 4 → 3 (upgrade +2 → +1).
Gossamer – Block 4 → 3.
Animal Handling – Familiar cards 3 → 2.
Ritual Casting – Now stacks. Each copy frees one more random card in hand whenever you play a card costing 2 or more.
Bind in Blood – Now costs 1 HP to play.
Cloak of Moonlight – Cost 2 → 1. Upgrade now grants Innate (was cost reduction).
Wisdom (Owl) – Now Draw 2 Discard 1. Upgrade now draws 3 and discards 2 (was draw 2, discard 1).
Swarm (Rat) –  Now adds 2 Rats to your Draw Pile and Discard Pile No longer adds a Rats to your hand. (upgrade 3).
Wicker Bones – Gains Retain.
Wicker Consumation – Gains Retain.
Tinder – Cost 1 → 0.
Creeping Vines – Brambles 6 → 5 (upgrade +2 → +1).
Stuck in a Bush – Brambles 7 → 8.
Wild Growth – Brambles 5 → 6.
Extract Life – Damage 12 → 10.
Needle Whip – Damage 8 → 9.
Star Dust – Moonlight 3 → 4.
Volatile Vapors – Stacks 3 → 4.
Pocket Rats – Upgrade now removes Exhaust (was: upgraded Rats). Rats it creates are always the base version.
Vile Renewal – Now also draws 1 card.
Salt and Ash – Block 6 → 7.
Vile Renewal – Block 5 → 6.
Fixed a hitch and "Asset not cached" warning the first time Bottle Barrage was played in a run.
A Little Sip – No longer grants Strength; now just draws a card whenever you use a Potion. Now Ethereal; upgrade removes Ethereal (was +1 Strength).
Bonfire – Can now exhaust Ash.
Tinder – Can now exhaust Ash.
Witchcraft – Upgrade now grants Retain (was +1 Potion).
Overrun now shows as a debuff on the trampled enemy, displaying how much damage each Familiar card will deal to it.
Bottled Message now keeps a card's grown stats (e.g. Capture Soul's bonus Hex) when bottled and unbottled.
Buddy in a Bottle description clarified: it adds a card that summons a Familiar.
A Little Sip – Whenever you use a Potion, now also gain 1 Brambles (still draws a card).
Animal Handling – +1 Card Created. Upgrade now makes the added Familiar cards Upgraded (was +1 card).
Bottomless Cauldron – Upgrade now creates an Unstable Noxious Brew when played (was cost 2 → 1).
Moonbeam – Applies Moonlight equal to the damage dealt (was a flat 10 (12)).
Mulch – The cards it adds are now Upgraded.
Smolder / Wild Growth – Playing another copy now starts its own countdown instead of extending the existing one: two copies give double the payoff over the shorter span.
Swarm – Now also increases Rats damage by 1.
Wisdom – No longer makes you discard. Draw 2 (3).
Bottle Wall – Block 8 → 6 (12 → 10).
Embrace the Wilds – Draw 1 fewer card each turn (was 2).
Extract Life – Upgrade now gives +5 Damage (was +1 Replay).
Gossamer – Block 3 → 5 (4 → 6).
Hide in a Bush – Block 6 → 7 (8 → 9).
Needle Whip – Damage 9 → 10 (11 → 12).
Noxious Brew – Damage 8 → 7.
Refuse Pile – Adds 2 Rats to each pile (was 1).
Sprouts – Block 3 → 4 (5 → 6).
Volatile Vapors – Damage 4 → 3 (5 → 4).
Wicker Consumation – Damage 20 → 24 (25 → 29).
Wicker Heart – Brambles 5 → 6 (7 → 8).
Moth Familiar – Shows up in the shop's Power slot much less often (~10% of shops, was over half). Card reward odds are unchanged.
